items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: What did Coochie Martin play when you were playing with him the other day?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Yeah. And, uh, from that on, I just kept on going, and I would work myself on up there, you know, when I found myself, I was, I was at Harry Porphy and Charlie Porphy running my own band then. I got with Marion Vanilla, and, uh, had my own line up there.
What did Coochie Martin play when you were playing with him the other day?
Guitar. Oh, Coochie, uh, Coochie played guitar.
